subgraphs.name: Remove Background (BiRefNet)
subgraphs.description: Removes or replaces image backgrounds using BiRefNet segmentation and alpha compositing.

subgraphs.name: Geometry Estimation (MoGe)
subgraphs.description: Estimates 3D scene geometry from an input image using MoGe, outputting a mesh plus OpenGL and DirectX normal maps.

subgraphs.name: Image Depth Estimation (MoGe)
subgraphs.description: Estimates monocular depth from an input image using MoGe, outputting both raw and colorized depth maps plus a mask.
